Dialogs.Dialog: Wait long？ It started raining, huh.
I just got here. Well, can't help the weather.
Sorry for the wait. Glad you got here first. It's freezing today.
Right on time, huh. It'd be great if it weren't raining.
It sets a nice mood every once in a while.
Yeah, right on time. With the snow, I thought you'd be late.
I wouldn't cut it that close.
I'm late! Sorry for making you wait in the rain.
Sigh... Poor, devoted Rinko, waiting out in the snow...
Seriously, how long were you gonna make me wait in the rain？
Way too late! I can't believe you made me wait so long in the snow.
I'm really sorry... Thanks for waiting for me.
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！ Don't tell me...)
Sigh... Why are you still at home...？
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！ Don't tell me...)
So you are home... Did you forget or something？
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！ Don't tell me...)
I thought I might run into you on the way... Guess I made it here.
Excuse me. I'm trying to get to this place on the map...
Oh, directions？ Let's see... Go straight down this road, and at the first light...
Just kidding. I saw that. You've got a good side to you.
Whoa, I won a free one!
▲小早川＊▲. Look, I won! Got an extra drink!
Huh, lucky you. Thanks for the drink, then.
▲主人公＊▲. I just got here. You too？
Yeah, just now. Looks like we're extra in sync today!
Wanna play rock-paper-scissors？ If we don't tie, you get a kick!
Hey, did you see a cat？
I saw one on the way and followed it, but I lost it. Oh well.
Haha, well, maybe it'll show up again soon.
(I'm a little late... Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲'s acting weird.)
▲小早川＊▲. You look kind of strained. ...Are you standing on your tiptoes？
Oh, this？ Just a little workout. No real reason.
Until I get bored of it, anyway.
(Something tells me that won't take long...)
(She's looking around for me... Seeing ▲小早川＊▲ like this really makes me want to protect her.)
What are you babbling about？ You're late.
(Crap... I'm super late. Oh, is that ▲小早川＊▲？)
(Is she talking to some guy...？ Oh... He left.)
Sorry. Who was that you were just talking to？ A friend？
No, some guy hitting on me. A middle schooler, too! Asked me what middle school I go to. Seriously, give me a break.
(So he thought she was in middle school...)
(I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ already went home...)
Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲, did you just get here？
Actually, yeah... Haha, guess we're both late.
▲小早川＊▲! What are you doing here!？
I figured I'd kick you if you'd forgotten.
By the looks of it, you didn't forget. *Sigh*...
Never mind that, just hurry and get ready.
Oh, I'm all set. We can head out now.
Oh, okay. Jeez, you had me worried.
(It's cloudy today, but weather like this is just right...)
Man, the weather's so gloomy today...
I know, right？ I wish it would just clear up already.
Sorry for the wait. The weather's kind of dreary today, huh？ Though I actually like it this way.
I know, right! We really think alike, ●.
▲主人公＊▲. Did I keep you waiting？
Nah. Anyway, those clouds look kind of iffy. The forecast was on the fence about rain, too.
The neighborhood cat wasn't washing its face, so I think we're fine. Its forecasts are always right.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲! It's really coming down.
Maybe we should duck out of the rain somewhere...
That was over in a flash...
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Started raining on us, huh.
I don't really mind, except holding an umbrella is a pain.
Is that... a roundabout way of asking to share mine？
That is so not what I said.
Owww, I slipped on the snow...
That was a spectacular wipeout, right out of a slapstick routine!
Did I keep you waiting, ▲小早川＊▲？
I just got here. Anyway, did you notice that tiny snowman over there？
Oh, you're right. It's tiny, but it's even got a face and arms. Someone did a neat job making it.
I'm gonna go take a quick picture, so... stay!
▲小早川＊▲! What's wrong？ Did something happen？
The wind's so strong, my skirt...
I got here too late, huh...
▲小早川＊▲. Did you just get here？
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I just got here.
Yeah... I'm fine. The wind just pushed me a little.
You look like you've got a complaint... Not sure what, though.
This is... from the other day. Hehe, I wore it today.
I really ended up liking this, so I wore it again.
I felt like wearing this present today.
Really？ Hehe. Guess it's going into heavy rotation for a while.
Yeah, I think it looks pretty good too.
Hey. Aren't you even a little impressed？
What is it？ Don't be so wishy-washy.
Why not try a new hairstyle？
Why not try a new hair color？
Why not change your hair length？
That might be nice. I'll think about it.
I see... And here I actually liked it.
...If you have something to say, just say it.
What is it？ I can't tell if you don't say anything.
What!？ I just changed it the other day.
I see... So that's how it turned out.
Yeah, yeah. You don't have to force yourself to say anything.
Hey. My hair's gotten longer lately, right？ What do you think？
Aren't you going to cut it？
Oh, good. I was thinking of letting it grow out like this, too.
You prefer it short？ Well, alright.
Wait, did you not even notice？ ...No way, right？
What do you think of this hairstyle？
What do you think of this hair color？
Um... What do you think of this hair color？ Come on, don't hold back.
Wow! It actually really suits you.
Really？ So you like this look？ I'll keep that in mind.
Oh... I see... So you're not a fan.
I'm hungry. What're we doing for lunch？
I'm starving. I might not make it.
Come to think of it, I'm getting a little hungry.
I'm starting to get a little thirsty.
Sounds good. Come on, let's go.
Hmm... I'm not in the mood.
Look, a break in the clouds. Seems like it's clearing up.
The sky's looking dicey. Hope it just stays cloudy.
It's snow... Look, look. It's coming down.
It started raining outside. Think it'll get pretty heavy？
Hey, it's coming down. Think it'll get heavy？
You're right. Maybe we should change our plans...
Yeah, okay. Now that that's settled, let's hurry.
Yeah... I think I feel the same way.
Don't get all needy on me.
Pay attention to your surroundings, will you？
I told you, no. Look... people.
I told you, I'm not in the mood for that.
Huh？ Hey... You're tilting the umbrella.
Hey. We're already pressed right up against each other... Isn't this close enough？
We're going to get rained on.
Come on, watch where you're walking.
Fine by me, just don't take a bad one.
I'm your model here, so don't make it blurry or anything.
Hehe, take a good one, okay？
No. I don't want to, so no.
Want to grab a quick bite？
I'm getting hungry... It's about that time, so how about lunch？
It's almost dinnertime. Want to go eat somewhere？
Yeah, sounds good. I'm getting hungry too.
Sure. If you want to go, I'll come with you.
Too much trouble. I'm not even hungry.
We're here already？ Was it always this close？
Oh, you have an umbrella. Boring.
...Look at us, both bringing umbrellas. What a well-prepared couple.
I should've forgotten my umbrella on purpose.
You don't have an umbrella？ Guess I have no choice... Here.
Oh, thanks. Then ● will hold the umbrella.
Forgot your umbrella？ Here, you can share mine.
Here, get under. Sharing an umbrella with me... Aren't you lucky？
Yeah, thanks. Lucky I forgot mine.
Here. You don't have an umbrella, right？
Here, why don't you share ●'s umbrella？
...Guess I have no choice. No getting too close, though.
Come on, get under my umbrella. You don't have one, right？
Okay. Heh... Glad I forgot mine.
No umbrella？ ● don't have one either...
Oh, okay... Not that I mind, or anything.
Are you... thinking you want to get closer to me right now？
...This feels a little more... like we're a couple, maybe.
Squeeze! ...Just felt like saying it out loud. Heh.
...Huh？ Was it supposed to be here today？
Uh... Sorry, I got the place wrong.
What are you doing？ Well, I guess here is fine too.
(If ▲小早川＊▲'s fine with it, I guess it's okay...)
...Hey. Um, is this where we were supposed to go？
Sigh, honestly. We'll run out of time, so here is fine.
(If ▲小早川＊▲'s fine with it, I guess it's okay...)
Now then, which game should we tackle first？
Hey, which one are we playing？
Why don't you pick whatever you want？
Hey, come on. Let's play a little longer.
Well, that was pretty fun. Want to try something else？
Sorry to wipe that smug look off your face, but I want to go somewhere else now.
Um... I made us lunch today. What do you want to do？
Eat it, of course. Lucky me!
I went ahead and made a boxed lunch. It's fine if you don't want it, though.
Hey, I made lunch. You're gonna eat it, right？
Then wanna come over to ●'s place？
Not there... I'm not really in the mood for that.
There's a piece of lint in it. Come on, bend down!
I said good morning to a grade-schooler in my neighborhood this morning... and got totally ignored.
Maybe their school tells them not to talk to strangers？
They should be able to judge case by case, though. I'm just a harmless high school girl. Kids these days...
"Kids these days"？ ...How old do you think you are？
Did you watch that special on TV last night？
Oh, the two-hour quiz show？ I meant to watch it, but I ended up forgetting.
It was super boring. Even after watching it all the way to the end, I still didn't get why it's so popular.
(So she did watch it all the way to the end...)
What was that？ You sound like an old man.
...I'm only a year older than you, you know.
Hehe, hope they're not talking bad about you, though.
They're my classmates. ...I see. So those two are dating.
Huh. Don't go spreading it around, okay？
...Those twins over there look identical. Hey, what would you do if I had a twin？
What's that supposed to mean？ Wouldn't you be thinking, "I wanna date both of them!" or something？
Oh, what a pretty cat. Definitely not a stray.
Can you tell？ It's not wearing a collar or anything.
You can tell just by looking at how glossy and well-groomed its coat is. You still have a lot to learn.
Hmm, I can't tell the difference.
Oh, I've got a little bruise.
Just playing Volvavin with my little brother. Kids play rough.
Ugh... My stomach hurts a little.
Huh...？ Are you okay？ Want to rest somewhere？
Hmm, I think I'm fine. I get this a lot, so it'll pass.
Okay, good. Tell me if it gets worse, alright？
Oh, you're right. Should we go say hi？
No, we'd just be asking for trouble. Come on, don't stare or we'll get caught.
(Does she have a guilty conscience about something...？)
Want to grab a light bite？
We haven't had lunch yet, right？ Want to eat somewhere？
Isn't it almost dinnertime？ What do you want to do？
Hey... I made a special lunch. Want some？
It's not even noon yet. Do you have a little more time？
It's still early, right？ Let's hang out a little longer.
Are you still good on time？ I'd like to stay with you a little longer.
Of course. I want to stay with you longer, too.
Great. Where should we go next, then？
Yeah. I was hoping we could stay out a little longer, too.
I'd like to hang out longer, too, but... I have plans after this.
I see. Guess we should wrap things up, then...
I want to stay longer too, but... it's getting late.
It's not like I have all day. I'm going home.
Nothing I can do about that...
Then want to stop by ●'s place？
Hey, mind if I... lean on you？
Hey, can I lean on you？
...I'm just a little tired, that's all.
I kind of want to... stay like this forever.
Want to miss our stop？ Just kidding... Let's get off.
Come on, we have to get off.
▲小早川＊▲. We're almost there, so you need to wake up.
...Mm？ I wanted to sleep a little longer, though...
Aren't you tired？ You can lean on me.
Yeah. I'm a little tired... so maybe I'll take you up on that.
No thanks... I'm just not really in the mood.
Only because you looked so lonely. I guess I have no choice.
If the train never stopped, we could stay like this... forever.
You can lean on me anytime.
Want to stop by my place？ I'd like to be with you a little longer.
Your place...？ Yeah, that sounds nice.
Right now？ Hmm... I think I'll pass.
Hey, I want to stay together a little longer... Is your place okay？
I want to spend as much time with you as I can, too.
Sorry about that. Come over next time, okay？
Actually, I have a present for you.
A present？ Oh, what is it？
Hehe, quit making such a lonely face.
Save it for next time we meet, okay？ See ya.
Huh, Kai？ S-See ya, then. Bye-bye！
Oh... I don't have my house key.
Huh, it's not in your bag？ What about your pockets？
My pockets？ Let's see... Oh, found it！ That scared me...
Haha, ● panicked there too. See ya.
Hey, want to come inside for a bit？ My brother might be noisy, though.
Since you're here, want to come in？ Nobody's home, so it should be quiet.
Are you sure？ Let's do that, then.
Oh, okay... Maybe next time, then.
Sorry, after you offered and everything.
You should just move in already... Hehe, I'm only joking.
Thanks, I had fun. See you.
Did I keep you too long？ Sorry if it was a bother... See you.
Listen... I had fun today. And I'm sorry.
I'm glad. ● wasn't considerate enough last time either. Sorry about that.
It's fine, I'm just happy we made up. Let's keep getting along.
Um, about the other day... I'm sorry. Are we good again... after today's date？
Yeah, we're good. ● will try to be more careful from now on, too.
Hehe... Thanks. I'll be looking forward to our next date, then.
Yeah, let's have another fun date soon. See you.
Um... I'm really sorry. Can you... forgive me now？
Don't worry about it. ● was at fault too.
Thank goodness! Let's go on another date soon, okay？ Thanks for today. Bye-bye.
